_comment: SplitLLM V2 — router-based local AI backend. Import via Admin -> Nests -> Import Egg. Requires the splitllm-v2 image to exist on the node (see deploy/README.md); it is not on a public registry.
name: SplitLLM V2
author: splitllm@local
description: Deterministic knowledge router plus a local Ollama model, exposed as an authenticated HTTP API with NDJSON streaming. Bundles its own Ollama so the deployment cannot come up half-alive.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# The application ships inside the image; the install step only prepares the
# data volume. Anything written outside /mnt/server is discarded by Wings.
set -e
mkdir -p /mnt/server/data/ollama
cat > /mnt/server/README.txt <<'EOF'
SplitLLM V2

data/splitllm.db   knowledge graph (modules, edges, evidence)
data/ollama        downloaded model weights — several GB
ollama.log         model server log

The API needs SPLITLLM_API_TOKEN set or it refuses to start.
Endpoints: GET /ping (open), GET /health, POST /v1/chat, POST /v1/chat/stream,
POST /v1/route, GET /v1/modules  (all except /ping need a bearer token).
EOF
echo 'install complete'

variables.name: API token
variables.description: Bearer token required on every request. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32. The server refuses to start if this is empty.

variables.name: Model
variables.description: Ollama model tag pulled on first start. qwen3:4b is the tested default; qwen3:1.7b for a smaller footprint.

variables.name: Bind address
variables.description: Must be 0.0.0.0 inside a container so Wings can map the allocated port.

variables.name: Port
variables.description: Must match the server's primary allocation port.

variables.name: Ollama host
variables.description: Leave as-is to run Ollama inside this container. Point it elsewhere (http://10.0.0.2:11434) to share one model server between containers.

variables.name: Max concurrent generations
variables.description: One CPU runner cannot interleave generations; above 1 they thrash. Excess requests get 429 instead of a silent slowdown.
